subject: Conditional credit request for alpha pilot - BrightStack
messages:
From: Sana Siddiqui <sana@brightstack.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request: conditional credit allowance for alpha pilot

Hi Karthik —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We kicked off integration with our platform last Monday but hit a blocker in the data mapping layer that pushed our timeline out by ~3 weeks. The team expects to need an additional ~5,000 USD worth of credits to complete the alpha (mostly embeddings and reranking tests).

Is Redwood able to provide a short, conditional top-up or a 30-day extension on our existing promo credits? We’re willing to sign a short amendment or confirm milestone criteria — our priority is to finish the alpha and finalize the PO. I attached a brief timeline and a usage snapshot so you can see where the burn is concentrated.

Attachments: alpha-integration-timeline.pdf (PDF), usage-snapshot.csv (CSV)

Happy to jump on a quick call if that helps.

— Sana
Sana Siddiqui
Head of Platform
BrightStack
sana@brightstack.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Sana Siddiqui <sana@brightstack.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: conditional credit allowance for alpha pilot

Sana —

Appreciate the context and the timeline. Sorry to hear about the mapping blocker — that’s the sort of thing we want cleared before you hit production. I’ve looped in Grace (solutions) to confirm the technical milestone and Laura (billing) to assess the credit/AMEND path. I’ve also cc'd Rishi for visibility on the commercial side.

Two immediate options we can consider:
- Short option: 14-day extension of current promo credits + a conditional coupon of up to $3k if you hit the agreed integration milestone.
- Full top-up: a one-off $5k credit with a signed amendment (accounts will need PO/confirmation).

If you can confirm the exact token burn you expect over the next 30 days and the acceptance criteria for the milestone (e.g., embeddings accuracy threshold + successful rerank pipeline test), Grace can confirm whether $3k is likely to be sufficient. Laura — can your team provision a conditional coupon or do you need a signed doc first?

If it helps, we can provision a short-lived coupon today while we finalize paperwork, but we usually require an email acceptance or a DocuSign amendment for anything over $2.5k.

Karthik
VP, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Sana Siddiqui <sana@brightstack.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 10:22:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: conditional credit allowance for alpha pilot

Sana —

Thanks for the detail and the attachments. I reviewed your usage snapshot and chatted with the integration team; your spike is concentrated in embedding generation during dataset prep and a brief rerank/selection sweep. Based on that profile, a $3,000 coupon plus a 14-day extension should let you complete the critical tests and confirm the final burn rate.

Proposed approach (low friction):
1) We issue a coupon code: ALPHA-3K-030 valid for 30 days; coupon applies only to token generation API calls for the BrightStack account (to prevent accidental consumption).
2) You confirm completion of two milestones: (a) mapping tests pass (unit test report), (b) rerank pipeline meets sample throughput (50 qps for synthetic data).
3) Upon milestone confirmation we’ll convert the coupon to a formal one-off credit record in the account; if milestones aren’t met within 30 days the coupon will expire and we’ll revisit.

I attached a small milestone checklist you can paste into your ticketing system. Also, please confirm the expected token burn (approx tokens/day) so we can set a reasonable cap.

Attachments: milestone-checklist.md

If that sounds reasonable to you, I can ask Laura to provision a temporary coupon today while legal/accounting review the amendment.

— Grace
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Sana Siddiqui <sana@brightstack.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 14:00:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: conditional credit allowance for alpha pilot

Following Grace’s recommendation — finance can approve a one-off $3,000 coupon today as an interim measure. A few notes on process:

- For coupons <= $2,500 we can apply immediately on email confirmation. For $3,000 we need a short email approval from the customer noting acceptance of the milestone conditions or a signed amendment.
- We created a simple credit approval sheet (attached) that we’ll file for audit. If you prefer DocuSign, here’s the link: https://app.redwood.com/docusign/BS-834-amend
- If BrightStack has a procurement PO, please attach it (procurement@brightstack.com cc’d).

If you send a one-line acceptance like “BrightStack accepts the milestone conditions and authorizes a $3,000 coupon” we can provision the coupon today and set the account cap.

Attachments: credit-approval-sheet.xlsx

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Sana Siddiqui <sana@brightstack.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightstack.com
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 15:30:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: conditional credit allowance for alpha pilot

Laura / Grace / Karthik —

BrightStack accepts the milestone conditions and authorizes a $3,000 coupon under the terms Grace outlined. Please proceed to provision ALPHA-3K-030 and set the account cap to prevent overconsumption while we complete the integration. Procurement will follow up with a PO (PO# BS-2027-119) and I’ll sign the DocuSign amendment if required.

Thanks for the fast turnaround — this keeps our alpha schedule intact.

— Sana
Head of Platform, BrightStack
procurement@brightstack.com
